power.method: 10000mAh rechargeable battery; DC 5V/2A or Imou 5W solar panel

features: AI tracking (330 pan / 85 tilt motorized head)
release_notes: AOV Track Plus: Wi-Fi 6 battery/solar AOV pan-tilt camera, 1/2.5" 8MP sensor, 10000mAh. Specs from Imou's official spec-page table. As a low-power AOV camera it does not list RTSP/ONVIF, so protocols/configs are omitted. No official IPC code published; min-lux not stated. Corrected 2026-10-30 against the official Imou spec sheet: added the official 8MP model code IPC-V7M-U-8X0S2/FSP14 (the spec page also lists IPC-V7M-U-6X0S2/FSP14 for the 6MP variant) and the datasheet source; specs otherwise confirmed.

frigate.notes: 100% wire-free battery AOV camera — it sleeps between events and does not expose a continuous local RTSP stream, so Frigate/local-NVR use is not supported. Recording is via the Imou Life app + cloud and on-device microSD.
